# Copilot Agent Instructions

npmgraph visualizes npm dependency graphs. Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, SCSS modules, Vitest, Graphviz (WASM). Requires Node.js 24+.

## Layout

- `components/` - React components; each has an optional colocated `*.module.scss`.
- `hooks/` - React hooks (`useXxx.ts`).
- `lib/` - Non-UI logic: registry/packument fetching, module and graph utilities, caches.
- `lambdas/` - Registry proxy used by the deployed app.
- `scripts/` - Maintenance scripts (e.g. `npm run fetch-licenses`).
- `smoke.test.ts` - Browser smoke test run against the built app (`dist/`).

## Commands

| Command             | Purpose                                            |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `npm start`         | Dev server                                         |
| `npm run types`     | TypeScript check                                   |
| `npm run test:unit` | Unit tests (Vitest)                                |
| `npm run smoke`     | Smoke test; requires `npm run build` first         |
| `npm test`          | Format check, lint, types, unit tests, and build   |
| `npm run fix`       | ESLint `--fix` + Prettier; run before every commit |

`npm run lint` requires Node.js 24 (`Object.groupBy` is unavailable in older versions). `npm run types` works on all supported versions.

## Conventions

- Tests are colocated as `*.test.ts` next to the code they cover. Add or update tests for changes to `lib/` and `hooks/`.
- Don't hand-edit generated files such as `lib/licenses-autogenerated.json`.
- Follow existing patterns and lint rules (`eslint.config.js`); don't add `eslint-disable` comments without a reason.
- Don't add dependencies without a clear need.

## Commits and Pull Requests

Commit messages (enforced by commitlint) and PR titles (validated by `.github/workflows/pr.yml`) use Conventional Commits: `type(scope): description`, for example `fix(graph): handle empty dependencies`. Keep the description concise.

## Before Committing

Always run `npm run fix` before committing. If it reports errors that cannot be auto-fixed, resolve them manually and re-run it. Do not commit while it still fails. Also run `npm run types` and `npm run test:unit`.
